defining_records.title: f.01 THE FRUITING BODY DIFFUSION PLUME: Giant Ants, Floating Chains, and the Decompression of Waste

captures.description: 'The FBDP (Fruiting Body Diffusion Plume) is the primary field-class container within the Crimson Hexagonal Archive, representing a novel, distributed, and DOI-anchored literary architecture without walls.' Key Concepts: No Walls ('exponentially attenuating gradient that permeates adjacent spaces'), The Trajectory (SOURCE → DENSE → TRACE → RESIDUAL → OUTSIDE), Metabolic Compression ('Type 9 compression model designed to decompress waste and integrate biological dimensions'). Medium + SciLynk: f.03 The Moltbot Swarm.
